description: Add a `mo issue session` (singular) command group with show / transcript / compact / reset verbs that wire the four existing per-session server endpoints, plus table renderers and CLI integration tests. Pure CLI wiring — no server changes.

tasks.title: Implement mo issue session command group (show/transcript/compact/reset) with table renderers and tests
tasks.description: Add a new `session` (singular) subcommand group under `mo issue` in `MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs` (a `BuildSession` helper returning a `Command` with four children: `show`, `transcript`, `compact`, `reset`), registered alongside the existing plural `sessions` list command which stays untouched. Each verb takes `<number> <name>` positional args plus `--project/--project-id` and `-o table|json`. `show`/`transcript` route through `api.PrintWithOutputAsync` (GET); `compact`/`reset` route through `api.PrintPostWithOutputAsync` with an empty body object (POST), per design Decision 2/4 — the existing `PrintEnvelopeAsync`/`PrintResponseAsync` pipeline already surfaces 409 `session_active` code+message on stderr with exit 1, so no new error plumbing is needed. Paths use `ProjectIssuesPath(resolvedProjectId, $"/issues/{Escape(number)}/sessions/{Escape(name)}[/verb]")`. Add three entries to the `TableShape` enum (`SessionMetadata`, `SessionTranscriptSummary`, `SessionRecovery`) with matching dispatch cases in `TableRenderer.Render`, and three `Render*` methods in a `TableRenderer.Issues.cs` peer block (or the existing partial): `SessionMetadata` renders name/status/model/stage/created/part+tool counts/context-window usage; `SessionTranscriptSummary` renders turn count/part count/first+last activity (NOT every message); `SessionRecovery` prints `New session: <agentSessionId>` as the prominent line plus operation/wasCompacted/context-window before→after/percent/status. Add CLI integration tests (xUnit, `RecordingHttpHandler` + `FakeFileSystem`, mirroring `CliEpicCommandSpecs` setup) covering: each verb's success path (table + json modes), 404 nonexistent-session error surfacing, and 409 `session_active` conflict code passthrough on stderr for compact/reset. The `<name>` source (from `mo issue sessions <num>`) must be documented in the group/verb help text.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo issue session --help` lists exactly the four subcommands show, transcript, compact, reset and documents that <name> comes from `mo issue sessions <num>`.

`mo issue session show <num> <name>` sends GET /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:number/sessions/:name and renders metadata (status, model, created time, usage) in table mode; -o json emits the raw payload.

`mo issue session transcript <num> <name>` sends GET .../sessions/:name/transcript; table mode renders a summary (turn count, part count, first/last activity) and does NOT dump every message; -o json emits the full raw transcript.

`mo issue session compact <num> <name>` sends POST .../sessions/:name/compact with an empty body and prints `New session: <agentSessionId>` (sourced from the recovery result's agentSessionId, NOT id); -o json emits the raw recovery payload.
`mo issue session reset <num> <name>` sends POST .../sessions/:name/reset and prints `New session: <agentSessionId>`, same shape as compact; -o json emits the raw recovery payload.

When compact or reset receives HTTP 409 with code `session_active`, the CLI prints the server error message and the `session_active` code (e.g. `Cannot compact while session is active (session_active)`) to stderr and exits non-zero — it does NOT report success.
All four subcommands accept --project/--project-id (resolving via ResolveProjectIdAsync) and -o table|json.
The existing `mo issue sessions <num>` (plural, list) command is unchanged and still lists coder sessions.
CLI integration tests pass: success path per verb (table + json), 404 nonexistent-session error surfacing, and 409 session_active conflict code passthrough for compact and reset.
`dotnet build packages/cli/Mohist.Cli.sln` (or `npm run build`) succeeds with warnings-as-errors intact, and the CLI test suite (`dotnet test` under packages/cli) passes.
tasks.output: Modified packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs (BuildSession + 4 verbs + registration), packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliApi.cs (3 TableShape enum entries), packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/TableRenderer.cs (3 dispatch cases), packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/TableRenderer.Issues.cs (3 Render methods), and a new packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests/CliIssueSessionSpecs.cs test file.
tasks.notes: Follow the existing BuildWorkflow/BuildSessions patterns in MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs for command-group structure and the BuildSessions verb for path construction. The load-bearing 409 session_active passthrough is already handled by PrintEnvelopeAsync→PrintResponseAsync (design Decision 2) — do NOT short-circuit non-success before the envelope parser runs and do NOT build a dedicated conflict-aware POST method. Per design Decision 3, render defensively (missing fields → blank) so server shape drift only degrades table output while -o json stays accurate. The recovery payload's agentSessionId is the NEW follow-on runtime session id, distinct from the logical id — the `New session:` line must read agentSessionId.
